equivalence_argument: E3 window_runner hash f7bff5e... always called compute_server_weights. E4 pre-repair 3d44cecb... gated that call on uses_instant_calibration; for method=raven that flag is True, so the gate is a no-op and full-mode matches E3. Other ablation policy flips are False only on the ablated factor and do not execute under full RAVEN.

method_policy.note: Adds one-factor raven_wo_* policies; raven policy flags unchanged (all True).

methods.note: Registers ablation aggregators; full raven still RavenAggregator. raven_wo_inst uses RavenWoInstAggregator (P2 with λ_g=0, λ_β=1e-8).

window_runner.full_mode_path: When method=raven and all policy flags True, uses_instant_calibration is True, so the E4 pre-repair gate took the compute_server_weights branch identical to E3's unconditional call. Ablation-only gates (zeta/p/q/debt policy flips) are no-ops under full RAVEN.
